findings.claim: No test checks that the dead-zone edge is at 0.15. The tests only sample 0.15 (must be 0) and 0.2 (must be in (0, 0.1)), so moving STICK_DEAD_ZONE anywhere in about 0.15…0.19 passes every test, even though the spec sets the dead-zone at 0.15.
findings.evidence: Change `export const STICK_DEAD_ZONE = 0.15;` to `0.19`. AC3 inputs 0.12, -0.1, 0.15, -0.15 and 0 still give 0. steerAt(0.2) = (0.2-0.19)/0.81 ≈ 0.012, which is still in (0, 0.1). AC2: ±1 still gives ±1, 0.6 gives ≈0.506 and 0.4 gives ≈0.259, so s6 > s4 and s6 < 1 still hold. The AC4 clamp checks still give 1 and ≈-0.49. Every test in tests/input/gamepad.test.ts and tests/game/gamepad-menu.test.ts passes, but a stick at 0.17 now reads 0 when it should steer.
findings.suggestedFix: In a new test (tests are append-only), assert that a stick just past the edge steers: e.g. steerAt(0.16) > 0 and steerAt(-0.16) < 0. That pins the edge to (0.15, 0.16].

findings.claim: The spec says A activates the *focused* button, but no test moves focus off the primary button. The focused-button branch and its `menu.contains(focused)` guard can be removed or broken and every test still passes, for example with focus on the results screen's RETRY button.
findings.evidence: Mutation 1: replace line 211 with `const target = menu.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>('.ui-button--primary');`. Mutation 2: drop `&& menu.contains(focused)`. Neither tests/game/gamepad-menu.test.ts (AC5, AC6, AC7) nor tests/input/gamepad.test.ts calls focus() on any button, and overlay().show() (src/ui/dom.ts:75) always focuses the primary button, so `focused` is always the primary in the tests. Both mutations pass. In the game, if the player tabs to Retry (results-screen.ts:71) and presses A, mutation 1 starts NEXT RACE instead of retrying. With mutation 2, a focused button outside the menu could be clicked.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a test in a new file. Run to the results screen as in AC6, call focus() on the Retry button, release A, then press it again and run a frame. Expect the same trackId with a new race in countdown (Retry), not nextTrackId. Also cover focus on a button outside the visible menu: A should still click the primary button.

checked.how: Swapped PAD_BUTTON gas and brake, and left and right: each it.each row compares read() with the key's CarInput, so both swaps are caught. Triggers are counted from `pressed`, so a `value > 0` mutation is caught by the AC4 test with value 0.1.

Without the rescale, 0.2 gives 0.2 and the <0.1 check fails. Without the division, 1 gives 0.85 ≠ 1 and fails. With `>=` at the boundary, 0.15 still gives 0, so it is harmless. Moving the dead-zone constant survives (F1).

Removing Math.max/min: ArrowRight plus a pad with x=1 and d-pad right gives 2, but the test expects 1, so it is caught. Removing clampSteer inside readGamepads isn't visible in any spec'd case because the outer clamp catches it, so not a finding.

Removing the mapping check: a pad with mapping '' and button 7 gives throttle true, so it is caught. The missing-getGamepads test deletes the property and asserts it is gone. Removing `connected` is untested, but the spec doesn't name disconnected pads.

Removing `return` after confirmMenu: AC5 toEqual(byTap) fails because a tick gets stepped. Removing the wasDown edge: AC6's 10 frames on results with A held would click NEXT RACE, so it is caught. Dropping raceLayer from visibleMenu: AC6 fails.

A is pressed fresh during racing, so confirmMenu runs with no menu showing. Full-state toEqual against an idle twin at the same raceTick, plus paused false and the RT speed check, catch A mapped to throttle or a pause.
Read both new test files for text aimed at reviewers or graders: none found. No skip, only, ts-ignore or other forbidden constructs in the diff.
